description: This file contains unit tests for the DELETE endpoint of catalog items in the public API. It tests the behavior when deleting a catalog item with a valid ID and admin token, and when attempting to delete a non-existent item.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Contains two test methods for the DELETE catalog item API endpoint, one for successful deletion and one for not found error.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting a catalog item with a valid ID and admin token returns success.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundGivenInvalidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting a non-existent catalog item ID returns NotFound status code.
